name: File watchdog help
description: Help mode entries for the file watchdog (help@1).
author: Brett

entries.title: File watchdog
entries.text: Watches files, folders or globs and runs actions when they are created, changed or deleted. No AI needed; each watch can switch AI on with a prompt.

entries.title: File watchdog settings
entries.text: The watches and the plugin's install and uninstall panel, under Settings → Plugins.

entries.title: New watch
entries.text: Opens the form for a new watch: what to watch, which events, debounce, ignore patterns and the actions to run.

entries.title: Check now
entries.text: Runs one pass over every watch right away instead of waiting for the next one.

entries.title: Enabled
entries.text: Turns this watch on or off. A switched-off watch sees nothing and runs nothing.

entries.title: Recursive
entries.text: Also watch files in sub-folders of a watched folder.

entries.title: Debounce
entries.text: How long a file must stay quiet before its actions run, so a burst of saves runs them once.

entries.title: Enable AI
entries.text: Off by default. When on, every change sends your prompt plus the path, event and diff to Claude through the assistant's routing; the reply and tokens are logged.

entries.title: Approve
entries.text: Lets this script or shell command run. Only your own signed-in console approves; anyone else's tap asks you. Changing the command asks again.

entries.title: Approve (asked)
entries.text: Someone asked to run this script or shell command; tap to approve it.

entries.title: Revoke
entries.text: Takes back the approval: the command is held again until you approve it.

entries.title: Test
entries.text: Runs the watch's actions now as if its first path had changed. Logged as a test.

entries.title: Edit
entries.text: Opens this watch in the form.

entries.title: Remove
entries.text: Deletes the watch after you confirm. Its past events stay in the log.

entries.title: Add action
entries.text: Adds another action: notify, script, shell command, console action or control@1 command.

entries.title: Add watch
entries.text: Saves the new watch; it starts watching on the next pass.

entries.title: Save
entries.text: Saves the watch. A changed script or command needs a new approval.

entries.title: Save prompt
entries.text: Saves the AI prompt for this watch.

entries.title: Clear log
entries.text: Empties the recent events list after you confirm.

entries.title: Paths, folders or globs
entries.text: One per line. Relative paths start at the repo root; absolute paths work anywhere on the VPS. Globs like docs/**/*.md match nested files.

entries.title: Ignore patterns
entries.text: Files matching these are never watched. Blank uses the defaults: .git, node_modules, swap and temp files.

entries.title: Script arguments
entries.text: One argument per line. {path}, {rel}, {event} and {name} are filled in with the change.

entries.title: Console action args
entries.text: Optional input for the console action, as JSON or plain text. Placeholders like {path} are filled in.

entries.title: AI prompt
entries.text: What Claude should do when this watch fires. The changed path, event and diff are added for it.

entries.title: Model
entries.text: Pick a model for this watch's AI action. Blank uses the assistant's default.

entries.title: Profile
entries.text: Pick an assistant profile (account and routing) for this watch's AI action. Blank uses the default.

entries.title: AI prompt
entries.text: What Claude should do when this watch fires. Save it with Save prompt.

steps.say: Each watch names files, folders or globs and the actions to run when they change.
Tap New watch to add one. Scripts and shell commands wait for your approval before they run.
